preconditions.name: pavlovian_freeze_reaction_present_on_lesion
preconditions.description: The MECH-279 PAG freeze must actually commit on the LESION arm (pag_n_commits > 0 on >= 2/3 LESION seeds) -- the Pavlovian reaction the ilPFC suppresses. Below-floor => no freeze to suppress => the lesion-vs-intact contrast is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue (retune pag_theta_freeze / pag_duration_input_threshold to the Stage-H z_harm_a magnitude), NOT an avoidance verdict.
preconditions.control: ARM_LESION: PAG on (theta_freeze tuned to z_harm_a_norm ~0.34), harm stream fed, midline hazard band -- the freeze reaction must fire.

preconditions.name: ilpfc_gate_engages_and_suppresses_freeze_on_intact
preconditions.description: On the INTACT arm the ilPFC gate must (a) register avoidance-efficacy updates under threat (n_credit+n_decay>0) AND (b) suppress the PAG freeze (n_freeze_suppressed>0) on >= 2/3 seeds -- the SAME mechanism (learned suppression of the freeze enabling instrumental avoidance) the PRIMARY G_H lift routes on. Below-floor => the gate never engaged => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT an avoidance verdict.
preconditions.control: ARM_INTACT: gate on + protective-scaffold floor 0.8 bootstrapping suppression so the agent acts (not freezes) and accrues avoidance experience.

preconditions.name: stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal_on_intact
preconditions.description: Stage-0 forced supra-threshold benefit lights z_goal (>0.4) on >=2/3 INTACT seeds -- the goal-FORMATION positive control (shared from 603g). Confirms the curriculum is intact under the gate.
